highlights:
Mesh-panel construction: Open-texture sections at the toe and side sit beneath contrasting stitched overlays for a layered athletic casual look.

Lace-up adjustment: Eyelet rows across the instep provide an adjustable fastening, with the actual lace guides visible in the top view.

Sculpted sole profile: Raised sidewall details and a patterned bottom give buyers a clear view of the sole layout.

Collar and rear loop: A low-top opening with a textured lining surface and a visible heel pull loop completes the upper profile.

Assortment planning: Military Green and Black are listed in EU39-44. Send colour-size quantities, packing preference and destination for a wholesale quotation.
